mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST MoM > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a weakening supply chain, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO MoM < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS decreases over three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when PAYEMS > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 2% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when both RSAFS MoM > 2% and HOUST MoM > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% year-over-year signals a potential stagflation scenario, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.
